title: docs(data-modeling): currency is a bare number in both modes; defaultCurrency is the column currency only under fixed
body:
Part of #20090

Clause-②: no

Docs half of the card: the two `content/docs/data-modeling` pages triage named as the declared cross-domain surface (the card's item 1 and the addendum). The `skills/**` half lands separately on `claude/issue-20090-currency-mode-teaching` (Tier H, awaits human approval); #20090 stays open until both have landed and the seat closes it. Not a governed surface; no `meta.json` change (both pages already exist).

## What changed

Text only, re-derived from the spec (`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`: `currency` is in `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES`, "`currency` IS a bare number"; `field.zod.ts`: `currencyMode` `'dynamic' | 'fixed'` default `'dynamic'`, `defaultCurrency` default `'CNY'`, and the guidance "a fixed currency is declared as `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: … }` … A field without one uses the tenant default at runtime"; the tenant default's producer is the `localization.currency` setting in `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/localization.manifest.ts`).

### `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` (676 → 677 lines)

- The `currency` section's lead sentence now says the stored value is a bare number in both modes and the currency code lives in `currencyConfig`, never in the value.
- `currencyConfig.currencyMode` row: "Whether currency is per-record or fixed" → "Whether the column is pinned to `defaultCurrency` (`fixed`) or displays in the tenant default currency, the `localization.currency` setting (`dynamic`); the value is a bare number either way".
- `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` row: "Default currency code" → "The column's currency code under `fixed`; not the displayed currency under `dynamic`" (the row's own default is `'CNY'`, so the old description read as "every dynamic column shows CNY").

### `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` (459 → 465 lines)

- The "Currency Configuration" example authored `currencyMode: 'dynamic', defaultCurrency: 'USD'` and never said USD is not the displayed currency under `dynamic`. It now authors `'fixed'`, so the `defaultCurrency` it shows is the currency it displays, with the two modes explained in the comments.
- One short paragraph under the example states the rule: bare number in both modes, never `{ value, currency }`; under `dynamic` (the default) the amount displays in the tenant's `localization.currency` setting and `defaultCurrency` is not the displayed currency; `fixed` pins the column to `defaultCurrency`.

The generated reference `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx` is untouched (auto-gen; its "dynamic (user selectable)" wording is the spec describe's and is reported to the seat, not edited here).
